whyItMatters: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads an index URL that relies on SSH host trust.
actions: Depend on a published, versioned artifact, and keep local paths or branch references out of the committed manifest. Specifically: fix an index URL that relies on SSH host trust.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm .cargo/config.toml no longer carries an index URL that relies on SSH host trust.
